# NeoProCamX file-by-file and feature-by-feature review

Date: **2026-09-10**  
Source inventory: **2026-09-10 07:40:03 UTC / 13:10:03 IST**  
Workspace: `E:\NeoProCamX_Final01\NeoProCamX`  
Git HEAD: `58cff79`; working files include pre-existing modifications and untracked files.

Read the [bug audit](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md) for severity, exact source locations, triggers, impact, reproduction evidence and suggested corrections. It contains **35 primary findings and 8 latent findings (43 total)**, plus five engineering gaps that are not counted as bugs.

**No app was built or run.** No Gradle/CMake/Kotlin/shader compilation, app installation, emulator/device execution or network request was performed. The project changes made for this review are Markdown deliverables.

## Scope and review depth

Every one of the **3,941 selected files** has exactly one row in the ledger below. The inventory includes **2,956 source-code files** and **996,162 text lines** across source, tests, configuration, documentation and textual assets. Every selected file was read and fingerprinted; applicable formats were parsed. Semantic review concentrated on reachable features, ownership boundaries and suspected defects. **Mechanical scanning is not a line-by-line semantic proof.**

| Review depth | Files |
| --- | ---: |
| S3 | 96 |
| S2 | 45 |
| P | 545 |
| M | 2710 |
| D | 280 |
| B | 265 |
| **Total** | **3941** |

The source subtotal uses the inventory Kotlin/Java/C/C++/shader/JS/TS/Python suffix set; PowerShell, Gradle and other configuration/scripts remain included in the full file total.

| Code | What was done | Practical limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S3 | Targeted semantic/caller review in pass 3, in addition to applicable mechanical checks | Selected functions/branches and relationships; not a claim that every line of a large file was manually verified |
| S2 | Source cited by an earlier traced finding, retained in this reanalysis; relevant hashes/configuration were rechecked | Earlier evidence remains scoped to that finding |
| P | Syntax/well-formedness or asset-structure parsing | Does not establish runtime semantics, dependency resolution or image quality |
| M | Text read, SHA-256, declaration extraction and source-pattern triage where applicable | Candidate markers are review leads, not confirmed defects |
| D | Documentation/support text read and fingerprinted | Claims in documentation were not accepted as measured performance |
| B | Binary bytes read and hashed | No execution; extra model/PNG evidence is stated explicitly |

A dash in the **Findings** column means no confirmed finding was assigned at the recorded depth. It does **not** mean the file is bug-free. Features are a navigation classification based on ownership/path/name; a file may also participate in other features. Test-file feature labels are inferred from their component names and are not a coverage certification.

Excluded directory components: `.cache`, `.cxx`, `.git`, `.gradle`, `.kotlin`, `.venv`, `__pycache__`, `build`, `dist`, `generated`, `node_modules`, `venv`. The selected roots are app, core-math, tools, website, autopilot, .github, gradle and docs, plus root build.gradle, settings.gradle, gradle.properties, gradlew and gradlew.bat. Root crash logs/output folders, unrelated local setup state and private signing-material contents are outside this source audit. Excluded build products were not used to claim current app behavior.

## Recording modes considered separately

| Mode/flow | Contract inspected | Bug assessment and unperformed validation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SDR VIDEO | VideoModePipelineContractPolicy uses supported transport admission and a standard delivery contract; unsupported requested quality can be rejected explicitly. | Shared recording, storage, protection and gallery findings apply. Real encoded color/timing was not measured. |
| PRO/manual | UnifiedVideoControlCoordinator separates supported user overrides, measured automatic WB and AI focus authority. | AI tracking findings can affect their consumers. Physical ISO/shutter/WB/focus behavior needs HAL validation. |
| LOG | The mode contract selects LOG identity and the current color path uses NeoLog; legacy ARRI paths are distinct. | [LAT-008](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#lat-008) is a dormant helper defect. No claim is made that it corrupts current NeoLog files. |
| NDR10+/NIVUKX/APEX | SensorLinearNdrModePolicy and video capability policy distinguish RAW-derived processing eligibility from output HDR transport; NIV99 protects frame/source identity. | Shared [BUG-006](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-006) validation semantics and conversion/storage findings remain. Claimed dynamic range, HDR output and GPU parity need device evidence. |
| NPV10 | Native master writer and audio sidecar use separate ownership; catalog/recovery and metadata parsing were traced. | [BUG-001](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-001), [BUG-007](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-007), [BUG-011](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-011). No sustained recording or writer-fault test execution. |
| NPRAW/RAW | RAW sensor samples remain separate from display processing; audio explicitly preserves the sensor timeline, including pause gaps. | Current inspection does not establish a RAW sample-corruption or A/V-drift bug. Publication/recovery/device storage remain validation boundaries. |
| Still from VIDEO/PRO/LOG/NDR/RAW | StillPhotoCaptureModePolicy chooses single, bracket, recording snapshot or DNG companion behavior; photo mode normalization is intentional. | [BUG-034](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-034) affects eligible HDR batches; [BUG-032](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-032)/[BUG-033](BUG_AUDIT_2026-09-10.md#bug-033) affect custom-LUT behavior. |

## Bug classes checked

The review considered syntax/configuration, invalid input, integer/float math, frame/timestamp identity, color/model contracts, concurrency, lifecycle/cancellation, resource leaks, storage transactions and recovery, UI state, accessibility, security/trust boundaries, portability, test reliability, and performance-sensitive allocation/blocking paths. Runtime-only failures such as HAL crashes, GPU driver behavior, actual ANRs, memory peaks and sustained thermal/frame-rate problems remain unmeasured. No severity was inferred solely from a pattern match or a large file.
